content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Lake Charles

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you hold a secondary degree or equivalent and meet the education requirement. Unlike the PMP®, CAPM® requires no prior project management work experience, making it accessible to career-changers and recent graduates entering the field.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot camp. Our intensive format compresses coursework into a focused schedule, covering PMI's standard curriculum while keeping pace with your professional obligations in Lake Charles.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your CAPM® application, confirming your education hours and eligibility. Pay the associated exam fee directly through PMI's portal to secure your testing authorization.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM® Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice questions and targeted review sessions. Schedule your exam at an authorized testing center and demonstrate mastery of project management fundamentals.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: Earn professional development units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your CAPM® active. Engage in continuing education, volunteer work, or additional certifications to meet PMI's maintenance standards.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
